definitions.explanation: Making the same mistake or suffering the same misfortune as someone before; nearly always in {二|に}の{舞|まい}を{演|えん}じる or {二|に}の{舞|まい}になる.

examples.japanese: {二|に}の{舞|まい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{避|さ}けたい→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。
examples.english: I want to avoid making the same mistake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{兄|あに}→兄：00570_ani⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二|に}の{舞|まい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じて→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I ended up making the same mistake my brother did.

examples.japanese: ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二|に}の{舞|まい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧よう、⟦{慎重|しんちょう}→慎重：03264_shinchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: We planned carefully so as not to repeat the former president's failure.

notes:
From gagaku dance: the second dance ({二|に}の{舞|まい}) imitates the first one clumsily. Always about repeating a failure, never a success.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二|に}の{舞|まい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{演|えん}じる→演じる：13330_enjiru⟧: to repeat X's mistake
- X⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二|に}の{舞|まい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to end up the same way as X
- {二|に}の{舞|まい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}む→踏む：01197_fumu⟧: a common but nonstandard blend with ⟦{二|に}の{足|あし}を{踏|ふ}む→二の足を踏む：10095_ninoashiwofumu⟧ (to hesitate)

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{二|に}の{足|あし}を{踏|ふ}む→二の足を踏む：10095_ninoashiwofumu⟧ means "to hesitate", a different idiom
